classification.difficultyReason: Combines exterior angles of a cyclic quadrilateral, angles standing on the same arc and a triangle angle sum.

content.prompt: Find the values of the pronumerals.

spec.description: Cyclic quadrilateral with both diagonals, extensions of its lower side beyond both endpoints, and x in the intersection sector towards the left and bottom-left vertices. Vertex names used internally are not printed.
spec.mathematics: Internal vertices A, B, C, D run from left to top to right-lower to bottom-left. Angle BAC is 50 degrees. Exterior angles at D and C are 82 and 106 degrees respectively. E is the intersection of AC and BD; x is angle AED.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the source givens 50°, 82°, 106° and pronumeral x are visible; the supplied answer is omitted.

answer.worked:
Call the left, top, right-lower and bottom-left vertices $A,B,C,D$, respectively, and the diagonal intersection $E$.

The exterior angle of a cyclic quadrilateral equals the opposite interior angle. Hence $\angle BAD=106^\circ$. Angles standing on the same arc give $\angle BDC=50^\circ$.

$$\begin{align*}
\angle DAE&=106^\circ-50^\circ\\
&=56^\circ\\
\angle ADC&=180^\circ-82^\circ\\
&=98^\circ\\
\angle ADE&=98^\circ-50^\circ\\
&=48^\circ\\
x&=180^\circ-56^\circ-48^\circ\\
&=76^\circ
\end{align*}$$
